title: BNAI, NO-TOKEN, and MIND-UNITY: Pillars of a Systemic Revolution in Artificial Intelligence
rationale: Position paper naming a plausible-looking-reasoning failure mode in LLMs; conceptual framing only, with no agent evaluation and no harness manipulation.

title: WebVoyager: Building an End-to-End Web Agent with Large Multimodal Models
rationale: Web agent plus benchmark and GPT-4V-as-judge protocol; compares its setup against GPT-4 (All Tools) and a text-only variant without controlling harness differences.

title: LLM for Test Script Generation and Migration: Challenges, Capabilities, and Opportunities
rationale: LLM-based mobile test script generation and migration; no LLM agent, and the automation discussed is test tooling rather than an agent harness.

title: Beyond Intentions: A Critical Survey of Misalignment in LLMs
rationale: Text is a truncated publisher teaser cut mid-word and ending in Tech Science Press boilerplate; no usable abstract to screen.

title: Cognito: A Formally Verifiable, Metacognitively-Governed Architecture for Trustworthy Agentic AI
rationale: Conceptual agentic AI architecture with a metacognitive control loop and formal verification claims; no empirical evaluation and no configuration comparison.

title: XTestGen: Natural Language to Maintainable E2E Test Scripts with LLMs
rationale: Test-script generation tool motivated by LLM web-agent nondeterminism, cost and reproducibility, but it replaces agents rather than measuring harness effects.

title: A comprehensive survey on digital twin for future networks and emerging Internet of Things industry
rationale: Truncated teaser, but unambiguously a digital twin survey for future networks and the IoT industry, with no LLM agents.

title: Mind2Web: Towards a Generalist Agent for the Web
rationale: Web agent benchmark whose evaluation shows that filtering raw HTML with a small LM before the LLM materially changes effectiveness and efficiency.

title: Autonomous Tester Agent Benchmark
rationale: Record text is an OpenStreetMap Docker artifact description for self-hosting WebArena, not an abstract.

title: TErouting: Traffic-aware energy routing for electric vehicle logistics fleets
rationale: Traffic-aware energy routing for electric vehicle logistics fleets; no LLM agents and no evaluation-methodology contribution.

title: Exploring autonomous agents through the lens of large language models: A review
rationale: Broad review of LLM-based autonomous agents listing capabilities, challenges and evaluation platforms without varying or controlling any harness component.

title: Multi-modal zero-shot dynamic hand gesture recognition
rationale: Multi-modal zero-shot dynamic hand gesture recognition; unrelated computer vision work with no LLM agents.

title: TraceLM: Temporal Root-Cause Analysis with Contextual Embedding Language Models
rationale: Truncated teaser for temporal root-cause analysis with contextual embedding language models over event sequences; not an LLM agent study.

title: Hierarchical Span Matching for Root-Cause Localization in Cloud-Native Microservices
rationale: Hierarchical span matching network for root-cause localization in cloud-native microservices; graph neural method, not LLM agents.

title: Comprehensive Observability and Monitoring Strategies Using Datadog
rationale: Practitioner-oriented article on Datadog observability and monitoring for conventional software systems, not LLM agents.

title: Learning to Diagnose: A Dual-Loop Architecture for Few-Shot Multi-Root-Cause Fault Diagnosis in Microservices
rationale: Few-shot multi-root-cause fault diagnosis for microservices; the confounding discussed is overlapping faults, not agent harness confounding.

title: TRACER: Automated Metric-Level Root Cause Localization in Microservices via Anomaly Detection and Causal Inference
rationale: Metric-level root cause localization via anomaly detection and causal inference in microservices; no LLM agents.

rationale: Grounded agent that scores candidate plans instead of generating them, reporting that this scaffold choice lets a BERT-base LM set a KBQA record over larger models.

title: Graph-based Anomaly Detection and Root Cause Analysis for Microservices in Cloud-Native Platform
rationale: Graph-based anomaly detection and root cause analysis for microservices on cloud-native platforms; no LLM agents involved.

title: Towards Predicting Fragility in End-to-End Web Tests
rationale: Predicting fragility of Selenium end-to-end web test scripts; test-instrumentation work with no LLM agents.

title: Anomaly Detection and Root Cause Analysis of Microservices Energy Consumption
rationale: Experimental comparison of classical anomaly detection and root cause analysis algorithms for microservice energy use; no LLM agents.

title: URCD: Unsupervised Root Cause Detection in Microservices Architecture with HGAN
rationale: Unsupervised root cause detection with a hypergraph attention network over heterogeneous microservice data; not LLM agents.

title: The Elephant in the Room: Recognition and Documentation of Personnel Practices That Confound Reproducibility
rationale: Animal research personnel practices confounding biomedical reproducibility; keyword collision on confounding and reproducibility, wrong field.

title: Challenges of End-to-End Testing with Selenium WebDriver and How to Face Them: A Survey
rationale: Practitioner opinion survey on Selenium WebDriver end-to-end testing challenges; no LLM agents, and the tooling sense of harness is test instrumentation.

title: Insights into the enhancement of food flavor perception: strategies, mechanism and emulsion applications
rationale: Food flavor perception enhancement and emulsion delivery systems; entirely unrelated field.

rationale: Ablation showing that overlaying segmentation marks on the input image, a pure observation-format change at fixed model, sharply alters GPT-4V grounding performance.

title: Towards Autonomous Testing Agents via Conversational Large Language Models
rationale: Taxonomy and position paper on LLM-based testing agents by level of autonomy, with an illustrative example but no evaluation and no configuration comparison.

title: WebVLN: Vision-and-Language Navigation on Websites
rationale: Vision-and-language website navigation dataset and network built on VLN techniques rather than LLM-based agents.
